audit_boundary: Seal BOTH endpoints and the last raw candidates before opening the new128-record16-chain common positive C0/exchange-bridge/uniform-floor Q audit. At most128 residual-H centers per distinct arm candidate, reference H shared128; identical endpoint/baseline products are reused. Compute exact K2/HK2 via powers up to H3 on every new audit row. Whole-chain paired energy/variance, distances, importance and rare-node/tail readouts. No endpoint selection or update after audit. decision: No automatic remote production. Report endpoint gains versus K2 and neural-versus-free comparison, including no-update and rejection cases.
